blurb: Santa Cruz Harbor provides a variety of boating and marine-related activities and amenities for harbor users and visitors. It serves as the gateway to the Monterey Bay National Marine Sanctuary. The harbor offers a free inner-harbor water taxi service during summer weekends, holidays, and Thursday evenings during beach barbecues.
